about: #186: the one table for the install-lint setup-refusal copy. service/pack_install_lint.py and web/scripts/pack-install-lint-setup-copy.mjs (bundle-pack-entry.mjs) both read this file; neither has a copy of its own. `reasons` maps each machine-readable setup reason code to a `fixes` entry; a code that isn't listed (or none) uses `default`. `overrides` gives a reason its own `install` / `upgrade` template where the shared one doesn't fit (lint_timeout: "in time", and an upgrade that keeps the old version needs no fix); a template it doesn't list stays the shared one. Placeholders: {name}, {old}, {still}, {fix}. tests/test_pack_install_lint_setup_copy.py fails if the service and the script render any entry differently.
install: Couldn't safety-check {name}, so it wasn't installed. {fix}
upgrade: Couldn't safety-check the new version of {name}, so it wasn't updated. {still} {fix}
still_unknown: The version you had is still installed.

fixes.pnpm_install: Run `pnpm install` in `web/` and try again.
fixes.pnpm_run_prepare: Run `pnpm run prepare` in `web/` and try again.
fixes.try_again: Try again, and if it keeps happening, the pack may be broken.

lint_timeout.install: Couldn't safety-check {name} in time, so it wasn't installed. {fix}
lint_timeout.upgrade: Couldn't safety-check the new version of {name} in time, so it wasn't updated. {still}
